summary.text: Keith Erf is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 28 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Erf's career experience includes owning a business, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Keith Erf won the Hillsborough 2 general elections in 2018 and 2020, and the Hillsborough 28 general elections on November 8, 2022 and November 5, 2024.
Ballotpedia lists Erf on the House Finance Committee and its Division III from 2019, as division vice chair in 2021-2022 and as vice chair of the full committee in 2023-2024.
